convergent_finding.statement: Three coverage definitions land within five correct single leaders of one another. The gold region is already inside the tied leader set in roughly 185 targets; the constraint is that the tie is unbreakable from public inputs, not detection and not scoring.

corrections.label: B
corrections.reason: Locator terms are shared across every region in a section, so crediting them raises gold and its siblings equally; lifted golds arrive inside ties.

corrections.label: C
corrections.reason: The scoped candidate set spans several documents, so almost no term is shared by all; where the requirement narrows it only dissolves correct decisions.

decision: No change shipped; both corrections to the coverage measure discarded before implementation

mechanism.statement: Question-derived targets mix content terms with locator terms; _scope already enforces the locator half, and _coverage then requires the canonical claim text to repeat terms it cannot structurally contain.
